system_description.narrative_title: Escalating Russia–Ukraine war and its global spillovers
system_description.narrative_summary: Russia's military campaign against Ukraine is intensifying and producing wide-ranging military, economic and political spillovers. Cross-border strikes and large drone attacks (including strikes on Moscow and energy infrastructure), state seizures of foreign corporate assets, and concurrent legislative and arms responses from Western states are creating an interconnected set of pressures that affect markets, supply chains, allied security planning and domestic politics in Russia and Ukraine. The dynamic is widening the conflict beyond front lines into economic warfare, cyber and electoral arenas and international law/policy debates.
system_description.scope: Military operations (drone and air campaigns, strikes on energy infrastructure), economic measures (seizures of corporate assets, sanctions, trade/tariff legislation), political effects (Russian elections, repression, international legal disputes), and allied responses (weapons sales, sanctions bills, air-defense support, cyber/election security).
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical order and international political economy (security, energy markets, trade networks, international law).
adjacent_subsystems: NATO and Western military-industrial responses (arms transfers, defense contracting, operational planning)
Global energy and commodity markets (oil, gas, sanctions, trade disruptions)
International law and institutions (sanctions regimes, war crimes accountability, ICC tensions)
Information/cyber and electoral security (online attacks, domestic repression, diaspora politics)

variables.name: Military operations intensity
variables.description: Measures the overall scale, tempo and geographic extent of kinetic combat operations across the theatre of conflict.

variables.name: Cross-border attack rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency per unit time of strikes, drone attacks and other kinetic incidents that cross internationally recognized borders.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure disruption
variables.description: Measures the extent and duration of outages, damage and operational loss across energy production, refining and transmission infrastructure.

variables.name: Corporate asset seizure activity
variables.description: Measures the rate and scale of state-directed seizures, takeovers or administrative controls applied to foreign-owned commercial assets.

variables.name: Sanctions and trade restriction severity
variables.description: Measures the aggregate breadth and restrictiveness of economic sanctions, tariffs and trade controls applied in response to the conflict.

variables.name: Arms transfer volume
variables.description: Measures the flow rate and quantity of military equipment, munitions and support delivered to conflict parties or proximate actors.

variables.name: Air‑defense capacity
variables.description: Measures the deployed and operational capability of integrated air‑defense systems and intercept assets available in the theatre.

variables.name: Cyber-attack activity level
variables.description: Measures the frequency, scale and sophistication of offensive cyber operations targeting infrastructure, institutions or information environments related to the conflict.

variables.name: Election interference activity
variables.description: Measures the intensity and prevalence of actions aimed at influencing or disrupting electoral processes, including disinformation and technical interference.

variables.name: Domestic repression intensity
variables.description: Measures the level of political repression, civil liberties restrictions and punitive actions taken against dissent within affected jurisdictions.

variables.name: Allied security coordination strength
variables.description: Measures the degree of operational, intelligence and policy coordination among aligned actors responding to the conflict.

variables.name: International legal and policy contestation
variables.description: Measures the volume and intensity of disputes, litigation, sanctions debates and policy negotiations in international legal and multilateral fora related to the conflict.

variables.name: Global energy market volatility
variables.description: Measures price volatility, supply uncertainty and short‑term fluctuations in global energy markets attributable to the conflict and related measures.

variables.name: Supply chain disruption level
variables.description: Measures the extent of interruptions, delays and rerouting across critical export/import logistics and industrial supply chains linked to the conflict.

variables.name: Financial market volatility
variables.description: Measures fluctuations in asset prices, capital flows and risk premia in financial markets connected to the conflict and policy responses.

variables.name: Refugee and displacement flow rate
variables.description: Measures the flow rate of internally displaced persons and cross‑border refugee movements generated by conflict dynamics.

catalysts.title: US $2.7B air‑defense sale to Ukraine
catalysts.description: Formalisation and delivery of the cleared $2.7 billion air‑defense development upgrades to Ukraine, raising capability and support ties.
catalysts.rationale: "US clears way for $2.7 billion sale to Ukraine of air-defense development upgrades"

catalysts.title: GM production of Patriot missile parts
catalysts.description: GM begins producing Patriot missile components to address U.S. arms shortages, increasing supply of critical air‑defense hardware over coming months.
catalysts.rationale: "GM to Produce Patriot Missile Parts as U.S. Faces Critical Arms Shortage"

catalysts.title: Intensified Russian air campaign on energy
catalysts.description: Sustained Russian strikes prioritising Ukraine's economic and energy infrastructure, including refineries and industrial targets.
catalysts.rationale: "Russia’s new air campaign seeks to destroy Ukrainian economy", "Moscow oil refinery output halted"

catalysts.title: Further corporate seizures and external administrations
catalysts.description: Continuation and expansion of state‑directed seizures and temporary external administrations of foreign firms operating in Russia.
catalysts.rationale: "Russia seizes control of Nestlé and Auchan operations", "AptarGroup Russian subsidiary placed under temporary external administration"

catalysts.title: US opens new military bases in Greenland
catalysts.description: US establishes two new bases and a larger military presence in Greenland under a security deal with Denmark, altering Arctic posture.
catalysts.rationale: "EXCLUSIVE: US to open two new military bases in Greenland", "Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland"

catalysts.title: Use of new US tariff/sanctions powers on Russia
catalysts.description: Implementation or targeted use of recently expanded U.S. tariff and sanction authorities against Russian trade and major importers.
catalysts.rationale: "Trump signs Russia sanctions bill into law", "Russia sanctions bill gives Trump sweeping new tariff powers"

catalysts.title: Zelenskiy–Trump meeting in New York
catalysts.description: A bilateral meeting between Ukraine's president and the US president in New York that could influence aid, coordination and policy signals.
catalysts.rationale: "Ukraine's Zelenskiy says he and Trump agree to meet in New York"

catalysts.title: EU decision on lifting billionaire sanctions
catalysts.description: EU deliberations may yield a decision to lift or ease sanctions on Russia‑linked billionaires (Usmanov, Fridman), altering sanctions landscape.
catalysts.rationale: "EU continues talks on deal to lift sanctions on Russia-linked billionaires Usmanov and Fridman"

catalysts.title: Increased cyber attacks on electoral systems
catalysts.description: A wave of online operations targeting electoral infrastructure and vote processes around Russia's parliamentary vote and elsewhere.
catalysts.rationale: "Russia reports online attacks on electoral system on second day of parliamentary vote"

catalysts.title: Escalation of repression against Russian critics and exiles
catalysts.description: Ongoing intensification of punitive actions, legal pressure and harassment against critics, exiles and dissenting voices abroad.
catalysts.rationale: "Russia has intensified repression of critics overseas", "Russian exiles cast votes to voice dissent"
